artworks.label: Sandstone shark tooth
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for fossil-cove. One beautiful large prehistoric fossil shark tooth embedded upright in a small naturally layered limestone fragment, warm ivory serrated enamel, weathered sand-beige root, subtle sage-green mineral patina, a few tiny rounded sea pebbles at the base. Fine-art paleontological coastal still-life photography, tangible stone texture and softly rounded miniature sculptural finish, sea-mist sage and warm chalk palette. No ammonite, pterosaur, trilobite, amber or insect. Whole subject centered, simple readable silhouette, generous18percent transparent margins. Truly transparent empty background with alpha; no opaque tile, floor, rectangular frame or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numbers, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendar, UI, logo or watermark. Never copy/crop/recolour an existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
